attributes.title: inspect_resource_permissions
attributes.description: Inspect the permission blocks on everything that is not a page: AI agents, MCP servers, agent tool bundles, WebDev endpoints and named queries. This is the layer a manual review usually misses, because none of it appears on a security screen in the Gateway UI. Tool bundles are graded read vs. write, so an unprotected tool that changes gateway state can be distinguished from one that only reads.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Narrow to one kind: 'agents', 'mcp', 'tools', 'webdev' or 'queries'. Omit for all of them.
